title: merchant.validated.v1
description: L2 merchant validation completed for an onboarding case. Published by Onboarding (BC-3) at the end of workflow step 1 on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. Only WARNING-severity outcomes are carried: an ERROR would have failed the step, and this event would not exist.

caseId.description: The onboarding case this validation belongs to.

rulesEvaluated.description: Count of L2 rules run. A drop in this number between releases means rules were lost, which is why it is carried rather than inferred.

warnings.description: WARNING-severity rule outcomes. Recorded and surfaced to operators; they do not block the workflow.

validatedAt.description: When validation completed, RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision.

ruleId.description: Stable validation-plane rule identifier. Every rule id is documented with its meaning and remediation, and CI fails the build if one is not.
